'''2016 MPC Joe Pinto DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Pinto]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Pinto]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
